status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Commanders placed Croskey-Merritt (groin) on injured reserve Monday.
status.longComment: Croskey-Merritt had already been ruled out for Monday's game against the 49ers, but his move to IR ensures that he'll miss at least an additional three contests beyond that. With Croskey-Merritt sidelined through Week 10, Rachaad White looks on track to serve as the Commanders' top option out of the backfield in the interim, while Austin Ekeler and Jeremy McNichols are on hand in complementary roles.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: McLaurin left Monday night's game against the 49ers in the first quarter with a left knee injury, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.
status.longComment: McLaurin went to plant his left leg while running a route in the first quarter, and his knee completely gave out. He was unable to make it to the sideline and had to be placed in an air cast and carted off the field. With McLaurin looking at a potentially serious injury, Stefon Diggs will be thrust into WR1 duties for the Commanders. Antonio Williams, Dyami Brown and Treylon Burks will be tasked with playing increased snaps on offense.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Kinlaw (knee) won't return to Washington's matchup versus the 49ers on Monday, John Keim of ESPN reports.
status.longComment: Kinlaw is done for the night after picking up a knee injury in the first half. He had previously dealt with a shoulder issue last month. In Kinlaw's absence, Shy Tuttle and Deatrich Wise should be in line for increased playing time for the remainder of Monday's game.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Commanders placed Jean-Baptiste (pectoral) on injured reserve Monday.
status.longComment: Jean-Baptiste was already ruled out for Monday night's game against the 49ers due to a pectoral injury, which is severe enough for the third-year pro to go on IR. He's required to miss at least four games, so the earliest he is eligible to return is Week 11 against the Bengals on Monday, Nov. 23.
